groups.canonical_value: Prefers a hotel room with a balcony and asks for or verifies balcony availability when searching, booking, or evaluating room amenities.
groups.merge_rationale: Both candidates express the same concrete behavior: treating a balcony as a desired hotel-room amenity to include, ask for, or verify during room search, booking, or evaluation. The first adds contextual emphasis for unknown or higher floors but does not define a different default behavior.
